title: Taxonomic Classification Using Centrifuge
author: James Thornton
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f8qbrvw
materials: Go into the fastq direectory cd fastq

steps.title: Initialize HPC Environment
steps.instruction: Log in to the HPC cluster (ICE) and set up the working directory structure.

substeps.instruction: Log in via ssh: ssh hpc
Navigate to class directory: cd /rsgrps/bh_class/username
Create an 'original' directory and move all current directories into it: mkdir original && mv * original
Create directories for the pipeline: mkdir fastq unmapped taxonomy

steps.title: Prepare SRR Sample List
steps.instruction: Create a text file containing the list of SRR file names to be processed.

substeps.instruction: Use nano to create a file named 'list' containing the SRR IDs (e.g., SRR1647045, SRR1647046, etc.)

steps.title: Download Paired-End Reads
steps.instruction: Create and execute a bash script to download biological reads from SRA as separate paired-end files.

substeps.instruction: Create 'get-fastq.sh' with the following parameters: --clip (remove adapters), --skip-technical, --readids, --gzip, --dumpbase, and --split-files.
Set FASTQ_DIR to /rsgrps/bh_class/username/fastq.
Load sratools module.
Make script executable: chmod 755 get-fastq.sh
Create log directories: mkdir std-err std-out
Submit job: qsub -e std-err/ -o std-out/ get-fastq.sh

steps.title: Perform Quality Control
steps.instruction: Run FastQC for initial inspection and then apply a streamlined QC filtering process.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Load fastqc/0.11.2 and run fastqc ./*.fastq.gz
Create 'run-qualityctrl.sh' using fastx/0.0.14 to process reads with: fastx_trimmer -f 12, fastq_quality_filter -q 20 -p 80, and fastx_clipper -l 50.
Set FASTQ_DIR to /rsgrps/bh_class/userid/fastq.
Make script executable: chmod 755 run-qualityctrl.sh
Submit job: qsub -e std-err/ -o std-err/ run-qualityctrl.sh

steps.title: Re-pair Reads and Identify Singletons
steps.instruction: Use a Perl script to separate paired-end reads from singletons resulting from the QC process.

substeps.instruction: Create 'get-paired.pl' using BioPerl (path: /uaopt/perl/5.14.2/bin/perl) to output .R1.fastq, .R2.fastq, and .singletons.fastq files.
Create a wrapper script 'run-pairedends.sh' to loop through the 'list' file and execute the Perl script.
Set FASTQ_DIR to /rsgrps/bh_class/username/fastq.
Make both scripts executable: chmod 755 get-paired.pl && chmod 755 run-pairedends.sh
Submit job: qsub -e std-err/ -o std-out/ run-pairedends.sh

steps.title: Remove Human Contamination and Classify Taxonomy
steps.instruction: Filter out human reads using Bowtie2 and perform taxonomic classification on the remaining reads using Centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the taxonomy directory: cd ../taxonomy

Create 'centrifuge_tax.sh' with the following paths: FASTQ_DIR (/rsgrps/bh_class/username/fastq), OUT_DIR (/rsgrps/bh_class/username/taxonomy), BT2_OUT_DIR (/rsgrps/bh_class/username/unmapped), CENT_DB (/rsgrps/bh_class/b_compressed+h+v/b_compressed+h+v), and BT2_INDEX (/rsgrps/bh_class/bowtie2_index/human_index).
Load bowtie2/2.2.5 module.
Run bowtie2 with parameters: -q --very-sensitive-local -p 12, outputting unmapped reads to BT2_OUT_DIR.
Run centrifuge with parameters: -S (classout file) and --report-file (tsv report).
Create log directories: mkdir std-err std-out
Submit job: qsub -o std-out/ -e std-err/ centrifuge_tax.sh
Monitor job status using: qstat -u username

steps.title: Generate Taxonomic Barplots
steps.instruction: Process the Centrifuge reports using an R script to visualize the proportion of classified reads.

substeps.instruction: Create directory: mkdir barplots (within /rsgrps/bh_class/username/taxonomy)
Create 'cent_barplots.R' script; edit cent.dir and out.dir to point to the taxonomy and barplots directories respectively.
The script filters for hits with a proportion ≥ 0.005 (0.5%) and generates .png images.
Make script executable: chmod +x cent_barplots.R
Load R module: module load R
Execute the R script.

steps.title: Export and Review Results
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting visualization files from the HPC cluster to a local machine for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Verify 6 .png images exist in the barplots directory.
From a local terminal, use scp to download files: scp netid@hpc.arizona.edu:/rsgrps/bh_class/username/taxonomy/barplots/*.png .
Open images locally and report findings for each sample.
